handoff: Root first reads source/prototypes and links this new main to its already frozen CPU Debug closure85 NON-main objects and matching frozen headers. Never include/compile a cloned JSphCpu.cpp or link a second material implementation. CLI is FRESH_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY; target must not exist and its parent must exist. No invocation was performed during authoring.
actual_calls: Every point calls the linked global UpdateDPvars and Updatedfdk, then either ConsRelationEP_fast or ConsRelationEPsft_fast. No JSph object, spatial kernel, material source, public option or time integrator is changed.
cases: 36 observations: constant-strength and cohesion-only softening, each psi0=0,+2.5,-5 degrees and six labeled points. Float Lian values E20MPa,nu.33,phi=phir25deg,c5000Pa,cr1000Pa,eta5; sf=0 because baseline has no Eq19 implementation. Plane-strain DP. Paths are elastic,first yield,further loading,unloading,elastic reload,then an explicitly synthetic kappa=.5 small-overstress rounding probe. The last point is not a continuation of its previous history. No phi=0/apex division case.
independent_observations: Yield is evaluated independently from Eq16/18 using actual returned double stress and both old/new saved float kappa, with fixed-strength references for the nonsoftening path. A central difference of that independent yield at frozen trial stress observes df/dkappa. Inverse isotropic elastic compliance applied to ACTUAL trial-minus-returned stress gives full/deviatoric plastic-strain norm and volume; it includes final apex/radial projections and is not relabeled as the hidden first-return increment.
multiplier_and_rounding_caveat: Functions do not return lambda. All pred_lambda/pred_first_return columns are explicitly frozen-coefficient predictions for comparing plus/minus consistency signs and full/deviatoric norms, never claimed actual internal lambda. lambda_equiv_total_dev_return is sqrt3 times the independently inferred total deviatoric strain norm, not hidden lambda. predicted_float_loss combines the predicted first increment rounding to unchanged float kappa with the ACTUAL unchanged output; it is descriptive. Current material/history parameters remain float and stresses double.
gates: Only fresh-output, finite-record and write checks. Record old/new yield residuals, apparent norm mismatch, strength-sign behavior and zero history writes without imposing an accuracy pass or repairing them. completion means all observations were written, not material correctness, new psi softening, u-pl plastic compatibility, GPU or physical acceptance.
protected: No production source/constants, current Cryer data/reader/process, retained programs, inputs or evidence is modified. Root decides compilation/execution and later independent interpretation.
